primaryWitnesses.text: Under him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small;

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: “Etymology” lines 137–141 and “Original name for Jesus” lines 172–176: Yeshua is rendered Jeshua in English and 2 Chronicles 31:15 is listed among its occurrences; the article does not identify this individual by additional biography.
